Thanks, Alice — Thu 12/9 9:00 AM PT works for us. I’ll send a calendar invite to you + Rahul and put Marissa (CS) on the call.

Regarding keys: good question. For a quick onboarding run we recommend a short-lived test key (24–48h) — our SDK supports a simple refresh hook. If you’re rotating keys every 24h, use the following pattern during the session:

1) Use a short-lived test key created from the trial console (scope: inference:read).
2) Start the sample SDK with the test key and run the hello-world prompt.
3) If you need automatic refresh in CI, swap the key for a service role with rotation handled by your KMS — we can share an example config.

I’m pasting the tiny refresh helper we’ll use during the session (see attached sdk-setup-snippet.py). Also attaching the one-page checklist with the exact curl commands to mint/test a key.

Proposed calendar invite: Thu, Dec 9, 2026 9:00–9:30 AM PT (30m) — I’ll include a short agenda. If Rahul would rather have the session recorded, we’ll record and share the Loom.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
